takes/25_doctor_a.mp3.txt: That's called antibiotic resistance. It happens when antibiotics are misused, like taking them for a headache they can't treat or not taking them the way your doctor told you. The bacteria adapt, so the usual antibiotics stop working. Now we'll have to try stronger ones.
